📰 General

SpaceX IPO Filing Signals Potential Billionaire Status for Elon Musk •

SpaceX has submitted initial documents to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to pursue an initial public offering (IPO). The proposed offering is anticipated to be one of the largest in history, potentially raising billions of dollars. This move could significantly increase Elon Musk’s wealth, potentially making him a trillionaire. The company’s valuation remains a key factor in determining the offering’s success and overall impact.

🌍 World

Iran’s Retaliatory Strikes Mirror Israel’s Tactics – A Strategic Response •

Following attacks on Iranian territory, Iran has initiated a widespread retaliatory campaign targeting infrastructure and sites within Israel and the Gulf. The strategy involves replicating the categories of targets previously struck, indicating a deliberate command and control structure. Initial reports suggest thousands of targets have been engaged, creating a substantial and evolving list. This approach demonstrates a calculated response, prioritizing disruption and signaling resolve to regional actors.

🦅 US

Luigi Mangione Attempts to Delay Federal Trial in CEO Murder Case •

Luigi Mangione appeared in federal court seeking to postpone the upcoming trial related to the death of a Manhattan health insurance executive. The hearing concerns Mangione’s attempt to delay the trial on federal charges, which could result in a life sentence. Prosecutors allege Mangione fatally shot the executive during a confrontation. The defense is arguing for a delay, citing concerns about the handling of evidence. The court has yet to rule on Mangione’s request.

💰 Business

Tesla Halts Model S & Model X Production, Leaving Limited Inventory •

Tesla has officially ceased production of the Model S and Model X vehicles. Elon Musk confirmed that no new custom orders are being accepted, effectively ending production. Approximately 600 vehicles remain in inventory across the globe. The company’s decision follows a significant shift in its production strategy, prioritizing the Model 3 and Model Y. This move represents a substantial change for Tesla’s high-end vehicle offerings.

💻 Technology

Google Unveils Screenless Fitbit Rival, Leveraging Steph Curry Partnership •

Google is preparing to release a new wrist-worn device designed to compete with Whoop, focusing on continuous health tracking. The device, teased by NBA star Steph Curry, will be a screenless Fitbit-like wearable. Curry’s existing partnership with Google, spanning Health, Pixel, and Cloud products, provides a strong foundation for the device’s development and marketing. Initial reports suggest the device will prioritize data collection and analysis, mirroring Whoop’s core functionality.

🎭 Entertainment

April 2026 Streaming Guide: New Films & Shows Arriving on Netflix, Disney+, and More •

The April 2026 streaming landscape is set to expand with a variety of new film and television releases across major platforms. Gizmodo’s “Nerd’s Watch” highlights upcoming titles slated for release on Netflix, Disney+, Hulu, and Peacock. The article details specific genre titles expected to debut during the month, offering viewers a curated selection of content. Readers can anticipate a diverse range of films and shows becoming available for streaming throughout April.

🏅 Sports

New Trail Blazers Owner Tom Dundon Attends Blazers Victory, Signals Immediate Plans •

Tom Dundon, who recently acquired ownership of the Portland Trail Blazers, was present at the Blazers’ 114-104 victory over the Los Angeles Clippers on Tuesday, March 31st, 2026. He conducted an interview with Jason Quick of The Athletic following the game. Dundon’s initial focus appears to be on assessing the team’s current state and future potential. The interview provided an early glimpse into the new owner’s approach to the franchise.

🔬 Science

Perseverance Rover Uncovers Evidence of Ancient, Long-Lasting Rainfall on Mars •

NASA’s Perseverance rover has identified significant deposits of clay minerals within rocks on Mars, indicating prolonged periods of sustained rainfall. Analysis reveals that these clay minerals formed in the presence of liquid water, suggesting stable, flowing water existed in specific regions for thousands of years. Scientists believe this discovery strengthens the possibility that Mars was once more habitable than previously thought. The findings contribute to a growing body of evidence supporting the planet’s past potential for liquid water and, consequently, life.

🩺 Health

Actress Mel Robbins Shares Key Women’s Health Insights After Years Battling UTIs •

Mel Robbins detailed her long-standing struggle with recurrent urinary tract infections (UTIs) throughout her twenties. She initially attributed the infections to poor hygiene practices, attempting common remedies like cranberry juice and frequent urination after sexual activity. Despite these efforts, the UTIs persisted, highlighting the complexity of the condition. Robbins ultimately emphasizes the importance of seeking professional medical evaluation and treatment for persistent urinary issues.
